en: A black‑and‑white historic street scene along a narrow canal or stream. On the right, several plastered townhouses with tiled roofs line a cobbled sidewalk protected by a simple metal railing. A signboard reading "Ernst Müller" hangs from one building, and lettering on the shop window is in German. People in early 20th‑century clothing—women in long dresses and aprons, men in hats, and several children—walk along the path and stand on a small iron bridge crossing the water. In the distance more gabled houses close the view, creating a typical small‑town Central European atmosphere.
